Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, hematuria, and >100,000 CFU/mL Staphylococcus aureus, indicating a urinary tract infection. Glucosuria is present, possibly reflecting hyperglycemia. Low specific gravity may suggest impaired urine concentration. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation for UTI, consideration of possible underlying diabetes, and prompt antimicrobial therapy.
